newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens, Gazprom to expand cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Siemens, Gazprom to expand cooperation.

text.p: Germany's Siemens AG said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom to expand their existing partnership.

The two companies would jointly develop projects in the areas of energy production and distribution, plant technology, and automation technology, telecommunications and data processing for the gas industry.
In order to finance the effort, Siemens has provided a credit line, but a company spokesman declined to give any financial details.
Siemens planned to set up an office in Moscow to supervise the project and would also build a training and service centre.
The two companies have been cooperating since 1993.
